gap: No result ChatGPT got puts the whole LDAC field under $100 in one table with a price checked on the same day and each model's measured ANC-on battery next to it. Together those show the Soundcore Liberty 4 NC lists at $99.99 on soundcore.com today (2026-11-14), while ChatGPT's answers repeated $79.99 from Best Buy and Micro Center. They also show the two cheapest SoundGuys-tested LDAC pairs, the SoundPEATS Air5 Pro ($39.99) and CMF Buds Pro 2 ($35), cut 83% and 81% of noise, close to the Liberty's 84%.
standout_why: I compared against three rival pages. SoundGuys 'best wireless earbuds under $100' (2026-10-15, cited in every chat) already has the lab numbers: ANC-on battery for the Air Pro 4+ (6 h 17 min), Liberty 4 NC (9 h 53 min), Capsule3 Pro+ (3 h 53 min) and Air5 Pro (3 h 54 min), noise reduction as a percentage, and MSRPs. The SoundGuys LDAC page (2025-11-06, cited in two chats) already says LDAC cannot be used with multipoint. Skimwire (2026-10-24) has Amazon prices from Oct 24, including the EarFun Air Pro 4 at $53.16. What all three lack: a maker-store price checked today, any note that ChatGPT's $79.99 Liberty price is a retailer discount rather than Soundcore's own price, the Air5 Pro and Ear (3a) in an LDAC shortlist next to the picks, and the fact that the CMF Buds 2 Plus US page now returns 404. My best finding is a re-pricing of data SoundGuys already publishes, not a new measurement.
decides: Mostly confirms the picks and moves the money. At today's maker price the Liberty 4 NC costs $99.99, the same as the EarFun Air Pro 4+ MSRP. So on equal money the choice becomes 9 h 53 min ANC-on battery and 84% noise reduction (Liberty) against aptX Lossless, dual drivers and 6 h 17 min / 80% (Air Pro 4+). The Capsule3 Pro+ at $79.99 loses on battery (3 h 53 min ANC on). For under $50, the SoundPEATS Air5 Pro ($39.99, LDAC, 83%) is a stronger tested option than the CMF Buds Pro 2 ChatGPT suggested, because SoundGuys does not state LDAC for the Buds Pro 2. Anyone who uses multipoint loses LDAC on all of these.
